pk.context: 400 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: A 0.4-hour parent half-life against a 27-hour metabolite sets this hepatitis C drug apart.

clues.text: Its food effect is negligible, so it can be taken without regard to food. About 61% to 65% is protein bound, and about 80% of the dose is recovered in urine.
A crystalline solid, slightly soluble in water, with a molecular weight of 529.5.
Approved under an NDA in 400 mg and 200 mg tablet strengths, plus 150 mg and 200 mg pellets.
Boxed warning of hepatitis B reactivation, with cases of fulminant hepatitis, hepatic failure and death; its combination partners' contraindications also apply. Fatigue and headache are most common.
Chronic hepatitis C genotypes 1 to 4 in adults, as part of a combination regimen; children 3 and older with genotype 2 or 3.
A direct-acting antiviral nucleotide analog that inhibits the hepatitis C NS5B polymerase.
The generic name begins with S and has ten letters.
